content: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description We are seeking a Revenue Finance Director to join our FP&A team and own how Sonar forecasts, plans, and prices its revenue. You will drive forecast accuracy, partner cross-functionally to optimize revenue, and give executives clear recommendations on revenue strategy. This is a hands-on role for a self-starter who pushes back with data, builds their own solutions, and leads our AI-first approach to FP&A. What you will do Own the Revenue Forecast and Raise Its AccuracyOwn Sonar’s revenue forecast end to end (bookings, billings, and revenue) across monthly and quarter-end cycles, with a clear view of where we will land and why.Treat forecast accuracy as your personal scorecard. Track misses by segment, motion, and root cause, and run retrospectives on material variances.Challenge cross-functional teams on conversion, renewal, and timing assumptions, and drive the changes needed to make the forecast more reliable.Build driver-based models using leading indicators (pipeline, usage, renewals, price) and ASC 606 treatment; incorporating consumption based revenue models. About the Role The Director of EMEA North (UK and Ireland as well as Nordic countries) will play a pivotal leadership role in driving Sonar’s growth and success across these regions. As organizations rapidly adopt AI-assisted development and agentic workflows, you will lead a high-performing sales team to position Sonar as an essential foundation for modern software delivery. You will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies to achieve revenue targets, expanding market share, and driving software sales across diverse industries including finance, software, business services, media & internet, and other key sectors.
